records.key: {count} (well, gRNA) identities carry more than one 'fraction', so the gene's share of the well is ambiguous; for example {example}. Keep complete well identity, including screen when present, and aggregate counts by {keys} before regressing.
records.source: {count} (well, gRNA) identities carry more than one 'fraction', so the gene's share of the well is ambiguous; for example {example}. Keep complete well identity, including screen when present, and aggregate counts by {keys} before regressing.
records.translation: {count} 个（孔，gRNA）标识对应多个 'fraction' 值，因此该基因在孔中的占比不明确；例如 {example}。请保留完整的孔标识，包括筛选实验（若有），并在回归前按 {keys} 汇总计数。

records.key: a single independent physical well cannot identify gene effects
records.source: a single independent physical well cannot identify gene effects
records.translation: 单个独立物理孔无法识别基因效应

records.key: automatic horseshoe calibration needs at least two identified predictors; provide expected_hits strictly between zero and the identified count or an explicit scale_global
records.source: automatic horseshoe calibration needs at least two identified predictors; provide expected_hits strictly between zero and the identified count or an explicit scale_global
records.translation: 自动 horseshoe 校准需要至少两个可识别预测变量；请将 expected_hits 设为严格大于零且小于可识别预测变量数量的值，或显式提供 scale_global

records.key: automatic weighted calibration needs aligned likelihood_well_ids; arbitrary weights require an explicit scale_global
records.source: automatic weighted calibration needs aligned likelihood_well_ids; arbitrary weights require an explicit scale_global
records.translation: 自动加权校准需要按行对齐的 likelihood_well_ids；任意权重需要显式 scale_global

records.key: independent-well calibration requires exact inverse row-multiplicity weights
records.source: independent-well calibration requires exact inverse row-multiplicity weights
records.translation: 独立孔校准需要与行重复次数完全互为倒数的权重

records.key: likelihood_weights must be a positive finite vector aligned with design rows
records.source: likelihood_weights must be a positive finite vector aligned with design rows
records.translation: likelihood_weights 必须是与设计行对齐的正且有限的向量

records.key: likelihood_well_ids must align with every design row
records.source: likelihood_well_ids must align with every design row
records.translation: likelihood_well_ids 必须与每个设计行对齐

records.key: likelihood_well_ids must be hashable physical-well identities
records.source: likelihood_well_ids must be hashable physical-well identities
records.translation: likelihood_well_ids 必须是可哈希的物理孔标识
likelihood_well_ids 需要完整的物理孔标识

records.key: no identified nonconstant predictor remains for horseshoe calibration
records.source: no identified nonconstant predictor remains for horseshoe calibration
records.translation: 没有剩余的可识别非常量预测变量可用于 horseshoe 校准

records.key: one likelihood_well_ids identity must have identical design, counts and exposure
records.source: one likelihood_well_ids identity must have identical design, counts and exposure
records.translation: 同一个 likelihood_well_ids 标识必须具有完全相同的设计、计数和暴露量
